name: masterplan
title: Masterplan

constraints: The Markdown roadmap is a projection and cannot silently become authority.
No task may be marked complete without accepted evidence.
No lower-priority work may supersede a higher-priority active task without an explicit override decision.
Task priority is resolved from authority, dependency state, blocking impact, risk, and accepted project-owner direction.
Existing working implementation is extended rather than replaced.

purpose.statement: Own Savant project planning as an authoritative, graph-addressable, dependency-aware, evidence-governed capability.

responsibilities: Represent every project capability, onus, task, subtask, and microstep as an authoritative task record.
Represent all task dependencies, blockers, sequencing, ownership, authority, provenance, lineage, relationships, outputs, evidence, tests, rollback, and acceptance criteria.
Select the highest-priority executable task deterministically.
Preserve unresolved contradictions instead of silently choosing.
Record every status transition as an immutable event.
Generate disposable roadmap, queue, dashboard, dependency, bottleneck, and release projections.
Integrate identity promotion work without allowing it to supersede the active constitutional foundation sequence.
Expose stable interfaces for Codex and other execution agents.
Maintain full lineage from source roadmap text to graph records and generated projections.

capabilities.name: roadmap_ingestion
capabilities.description: Ingest legacy and current roadmap sources into proposed graph records without silently granting authority.

capabilities.name: task_reconciliation
capabilities.description: Reconcile duplicate, conflicting, superseded, missing, and partially implemented tasks.

capabilities.name: priority_resolution
capabilities.description: Resolve the highest-priority executable task from authority, dependencies, blockers, risk, and impact.

capabilities.name: execution_sequencing
capabilities.description: Generate deterministic task execution order while preserving explicit overrides.

capabilities.name: completion_validation
capabilities.description: Validate completion against accepted criteria and attached evidence.

capabilities.name: roadmap_projection
capabilities.description: Generate Markdown, JSON, queue, dependency, bottleneck, release, observatory, and agent-context projections.

capabilities.name: project_observation
capabilities.description: Observe implementation evidence and propose task-state changes without silently promoting them.

capabilities.name: task_state_promotion
capabilities.description: Promote proposed task-state changes through explicit authority and evidence gates.

capabilities.name: deterministic_replay
capabilities.description: Rebuild task state and projections from authoritative primitives and immutable events.

capabilities.name: roadmap_audit
capabilities.description: Detect drift, orphan work, invalid completion, missing evidence, dependency violations, and unauthorized priority changes.

rules: Each quirk owns one bounded capability.
Shared behavior is composed through explicit contracts and segues.
No quirk stores duplicated authoritative task state.
All projections derive from the same authoritative graph.

runtime.authority_boundary: Writes to authoritative task primitives require explicit admission. Projections never mutate authority.

security.boundary: No agent may change accepted priority, status, completion, or authority without an admitted decision and evidence.

acceptance: Every roadmap task exists as a stable graph-addressable record.
Every dependency exists as one typed segue.
Every status change exists as one immutable event.
The current active task is resolved deterministically.
The Markdown roadmap is reproducible from graph authority.
Codex can obtain the active task and governing context through one command.
Identity promotion work is represented without displacing SAV-P0-001.
No task can be silently marked complete.

apertures.purpose: Attach execution agents without granting authority to select unauthorized work.
Attach release planning and readiness projections.
Attach future task schema migrations without replacing current authority.
